description: Source file implementing LoRaWAN status and event status to string and error code conversions, specific to the lw_priv module in Zephyr.

methods.name: lorawan_status2str
methods.description: Converts LoRaWAN status code to human-readable string.

methods.name: lorawan_eventinfo2str
methods.description: Converts LoRaWAN event info code to human-readable string.

methods.name: lorawan_status2errno
methods.description: Maps LoRaWAN status code to Zephyr error code.

methods.name: lorawan_eventinfo2errno
methods.description: Maps LoRaWAN event info code to Zephyr error code.
